says: In next/, the approved watch plan's Monitor.ts exports a `down` input port with the DOWN schema for a program that monitors, and the built file exports none, so each program hand-writes the DOWN Msg shape.
proof: docs/plan/quests/watch-PLAN.md line 131 reads `export const down = { schema: Down, description: "A process this program monitors has ended" };`. The exports of next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Monitor.ts are MonitorInput (20), Monitored (29), MonitorRefusal (38), monitor (54), DemonitorInput (62) and demonitor (77): no `down`. Law M13's reader writes the shape by hand at next/apps/fabrika/src/worker-monitor.integration.test.ts line 82.
cost: The pipe slice and every later program that monitors guesses the DOWN Msg shape; the load check only looks for a DOWN port key, so a wrong shape loads and is found only when a DOWN arrives.
